title: It’s ok. Very different.
text: It’s ok. Very different.. Not gonna lie I THOUGHT this was a cover not an actual fitted sheet. Well I’m spite of that it’s super soft definitely warm. I’d suggest picking it up if you want to stay warm without a huge comforter. Not sure how I’ll launder this thing. But if you want something unique this is for you,

product_metadata.title: Paromong Fluffy Velvet Fitted Sheet Only, Extra Soft Plush Fitted Sheet, Super Thick & Warm & Cozy Fitted Sheet, 14" Deep Pocket (King, Blue Grey)
features: 【Warm & Comfortable】: The fitted sheet is made of high-quality microfiber. This microfiber bed sheet is plush, soft, thick and warm, which is very suitable for people who are afraid of cold in cold seasons, cold areas.

【Easy to Use】: The bottom of the fitted sheet is an extra-wide rubber band so that there is enough elasticity to tighten the mattress, to ensure that the fitted sheet will not shift, and to avoid the trouble of making the bed every day. The fitted sheet is treated with anti-static, will not generate static electricity, it is soft and skin-friendly in contact with the human body.
【Three Sizes】: FULL: 54"X75"+14", QUEEN: 60"X80"+14", KING: 76"X80"+14", suitable for mattresses with thickness from 6 to 14 inches.

【Easy to Clean, High Quality】: Machine wash in cold water, tumble dry at low temperature or air dry. No ironing required. This high-quality fitted sheet does not shrink, fade, fall off, or pill after washing.
description: This is a fitted sheet designed for keeping warm, the fitted sheet is soft and thick, and people lie in bed as if they were on a warm blanket. This fitted sheet is perfect for children and the elderly to use in cold seasons and regions. They bring the warmth of love to people in spring, autumn and winter.
